name: review
role: Use [METHODOLOGY.json](METHODOLOGY.json) as the sole methodology binding.
capability: Matt change review plus YY existing-code audit, seven-element findings and backend evidence. Requires an explicit review mode and its evidence anchors.
when_to_use: 对已有产出按评审模式评审：变更审查（diff/base+判据）、存量代码审计（范围+版本指针，无 diff 合法）、Standards 审查（repo 规范文档）、Spec 审查（起源需求）——按模式声明必需输入
